title: Plane turbulent channel / Poiseuille flow
description: Periodic (or long) plane channel. Laminar Poiseuille flow gives an exact parabola for verification; turbulent runs at Re_tau=395 are compared against DNS and the log law.

reference.citation: Laminar: u(y) = (G / 2 mu)(h^2 - y^2) (any fluid mechanics text). Turbulent: R. D. Moser, J. Kim, N. N. Mansour, Direct numerical simulation of turbulent channel flow up to Re_tau=590, Phys. Fluids 11 (1999) 943-945 (chan395.means: actual Re_tau = 392.24, centreline U+ = 20.13, bulk U+ = 17.54, Re_b = 13764; use the published profile files for profiles). Log law: u+ = ln(y+)/0.41 + 5.2 (S. B. Pope, Turbulent Flows, 2000, Ch. 7).
